sequence_description: Replay a SAML assertion containing <OneTimeUse/> with the same Assertion/@ID; second use must be rejected.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML OneTimeUse assertion was accepted more than once (replay not prevented).

sequence_description: Replay the same SAML Assertion/@ID after user-wide logout to test whether replay cache is incorrectly cleared by session revocation.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML Assertion/@ID replay was accepted after user logout; replay cache appears tied to session revocation rather than assertion uniqueness.

sequence_description: Tighten realm session/token lifetimes, then attempt an expired SAML assertion to ensure NotOnOrAfter is enforced independent of realm TTL settings.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Expired SAML assertion was accepted; NotOnOrAfter freshness was not enforced.

sequence_description: Attempt to replay the same SAML Assertion/@ID across two different IdP aliases in the same realm to detect replay cache scoping bugs (cache keyed too narrowly, e.g., per-alias instead of per-realm/broker).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_other_alias_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_other_alias_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Replay of the same SAML Assertion/@ID succeeded when routed through a different IdP alias; replay cache may be scoped incorrectly (bypass via alias switching).

sequence_description: Test whether SAML <OneTimeUse/> replay protection is incorrectly cleared or bypassed after a client secret rotation (config change) within the same realm/provider context.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML <OneTimeUse/> assertion was accepted on replay after OIDC client secret rotation; replay cache may be missing or incorrectly cleared by config changes.

sequence_description: Test whether SAML <OneTimeUse/> replay protection is incorrectly cleared or bypassed after a client secret rotation (config change) within the same realm/provider context.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_first_login_status < 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_first_login_status=400 < 400 → False
Implication: Control SAML login failed; cannot attribute replay outcome to OneTimeUse enforcement.

sequence_description: Start SP-initiated flow, then disable the IdP before posting SAMLResponse; broker must reject completion of a flow whose provider is now disabled.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_midflow_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_midflow_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence broken: broker accepted SAMLResponse even though the IdP was disabled after flow initiation (stale/atomicity failure).

sequence_description: Initiate SP flow, then change the SAME IdP instance configuration (issuer pinning) before posting SAMLResponse; completion should be rejected if flow is coherently bound to current provider config.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_issuer_mismatch_midflow_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_issuer_mismatch_midflow_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted a SAMLResponse after IdP issuer policy was changed mid-flow, indicating stale policy/flow incoherence.

sequence_description: Mid-flight principal-binding mode change: start SP-initiated flow with linkOnly=false (auto-create allowed), then toggle linkOnly=true before posting SAMLResponse; completion should be rejected or require linking, not silently succeed.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_newuser_complete_after_toggle_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_newuser_complete_after_toggle_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence broken: Keycloak completed a brokered login after linkOnly was toggled to true mid-flight (should not auto-create/complete under new policy).

sequence_description: I3 flow coherence: start SP-initiated SAML login, then disable the OIDC client before posting the SAMLResponse; completion should be rejected if the flow is bound to current client state.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence failure: SAML broker flow completed successfully even though the target OIDC client was disabled mid-flight (should have rejected completion).

sequence_description: I5: After tightening broker policy (linkOnly=true), re-auth via SAML should not auto-provision/authorize a new user; tests whether policy changes are ignored leading to over-grant.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_after_tighten_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_after_tighten_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After tightening broker policy (linkOnly=true), a new upstream principal still obtained a successful SAML login, indicating broker policy was not enforced and effective permissions could exceed configured intent.

sequence_description: I5/I2 edge: replay a OneTimeUse SAML assertion ID and check whether Keycloak still issues an authenticated session that can be used for authorization evaluation (should be rejected on second use).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Keycloak accepted a replayed OneTimeUse SAML assertion and could grant an authenticated session/permissions beyond upstream intent.
